comparison: All 17 raw stage files in each run match the hashes and sizes emitted after the original native diagnostic reads. Input norms and A/B projections match the GB10 BF16 rows widened to FP32. QKV/Z outputs already contain BF16 values: their mismatch is arithmetic, not an unrounded FP32 representation. Replaying K16 width-26 accumulation matches all 37056 reference projection values; FP64 and the old 256-lane FP32 tree fail the noted BF16 boundaries.
limitations: CPU component parity does not qualify a changed Windows runtime. The native Q1 projection route requires rebuilt model/streaming and continuation tests. Recurrent state, convolution, gating and later decode boundaries can still differ.
